modmenu.summaryTranslation.herzium: Faster visual hotbar and input feedback. Vanilla gameplay stays unchanged.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.herzium: Next-frame hotbar previews and a brief Attack/Use press acknowledgement for normal or remapped bindings. Vanilla keeps the real selection, actions and packets.
herzium.warning.title: ABOUT HERZIUM
herzium.warning.message: Herzium can preview Vanilla's currently resolvable hotbar slot in the HUD on the next rendered frame. A brief crosshair mark acknowledges normal or remapped Attack/Use presses without claiming the action succeeded. Ordinary non-combat items can also appear in hand immediately. Distinct same-tick slot bursts follow Vanilla's ascending slot resolution. The real selection, click queue, use and attack actions, and packets remain Vanilla. It does not raise FPS or change VSync, frame limits, Raw Input or cursor placement. The crosshair mark answers the button press, not the outcome, so it appears just the same on a miss.
herzium.warning.notice.raw_input_buffer: Raw Input Buffer is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.ixeris: Ixeris is installed. Herzium does not change its pipeline or Vanilla Raw Input.
herzium.warning.notice.inventory_tweaks: KoHs Inventory Tweaks owns Cursor Landing. Herzium never changes Raw Input or cursor placement.
herzium.warning.notice.both_pipelines: Raw Input Buffer and Ixeris are both installed. Their external mouse pipelines overlap; Herzium does not mediate them. Remove one.
herzium.warning.notice.exordium: Exordium is installed. Herzium bypasses its HUD cache, so that part of Exordium is inactive while both mods run.
herzium.warning.tip.0: Herzium removes waiting, not work. It adds no frames.
herzium.warning.tip.1: The hotbar preview follows Vanilla's queued slot resolution.
herzium.warning.tip.2: Herzium never speeds up the server's 20 ticks per second.
herzium.warning.tip.3: Vanilla still owns the real selection, actions and packets.
herzium.warning.tip.4: Combat items keep Vanilla's complete hand and equip transition.
herzium.warning.tip.5: Fabric API is not required. VSync and frame limits remain Vanilla-owned.
herzium.warning.tip.6: The crosshair mark answers the button, not the outcome: it appears just the same when you hit nothing.
